clue.text: Map confused seasonal goddesses in ancient vessels

indicators.note: confused means the letters of the word map are jumbled into a new order

parts.note: the Horae were the Greek goddesses of the seasons

explanation.surface: A muddled chart of the season goddesses turns up on some ancient pots.
explanation.definitionFit: Two-handled jars used by Greeks and Romans for wine and oil are classic ancient vessels.

clue.text: See 17
Fool with butter and what that says about food group?

parts.note: a banana is slang for a silly person, a fool
Rama is a brand of margarine, a butter substitute

explanation.surface: A dessert of fruit fool with butter, and a question about what that says on food groups.
explanation.walkthrough: The puzzle's theme is bands named after food: 'food group' means a pop group with an edible name. Banana fool is also a pudding, which helps the misdirection.
explanation.definitionFit: Bananarama were a 1980s British girl band whose name begins with a fruit, so a pop group named after food.

clue.text: Move home

definitions.meaning: in chess, to ... is a move swapping king and rook
an Englishman's home is his ..., the proverb says

explanation.surface: Two words about relocating to a new house.
explanation.definitionFit: Castling is a special chess manoeuvre, and a fortified residence is a lord's dwelling.

clue.text: Artist on the up managed act with lion

parts.note: Leo is the lion of the zodiac

indicators.note: in a down clue, going up means the word for managed is read bottom to top

parts.note: managed means ran, as in ran a business
to do is to act

explanation.surface: An artist whose career is rising managed a circus act featuring a lion.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'on the up' reverses only the word for managed; the lion goes first even though it comes last in the clue, joined by 'with'.
explanation.definitionFit: Leonardo da Vinci is the Renaissance painter of the Mona Lisa, the best-known artist of all.

clue.text: Vain daughters in French island loiter aimlessly

indicators.note: in means the abbreviation for daughters goes inside the French word for island

parts.note: île is French for island
D is the genealogical abbreviation for daughter

explanation.surface: Vain girls on a French island hang about doing nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Vain' is a second definition: an idle boast is a vain one.
explanation.definitionFit: To idle is to pass time doing nothing in particular, drifting about without purpose.

clue.text: Basted and broiled, battered ark yet berths one and one

indicators.note: berths means gives a place to, so the shuffled letters hold the two ones inside
battered means the letters of ark yet are knocked into a new order

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
I is the Roman numeral one again

explanation.surface: A ship's galley description: food basted and grilled, while a battered ark docks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'battered' rearranges ARK YET into TERYAK, and 'berths' puts I and I inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Teriyaki is a Japanese cooking style where meat is glazed with a sweet soy sauce and grilled.

clue.text: Current value given by a Frenchman — dad in Paris

parts.note: M is the abbreviation for Monsieur, a French gentleman
père is French for father

explanation.surface: A valuation offered by a Frenchman, who turns out to be a Parisian father.
explanation.definitionFit: The unit of electric current is named after André-Marie Ampère, so it measures how much current flows.

clue.text: Mother and son into horse as food group?

indicators.note: into means the words for mother and son go inside the word for horse

parts.note: a mare is a female horse
ma is an informal word for mother
a lad is a boy or son

explanation.surface: Mother and son climb onto a horse, apparently as a menu item.
explanation.definitionFit: Marmalade were a Scottish pop band of the late 1960s, named after a breakfast spread.

clue.text: See 12
Hot girl comes back for hair-dye

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hot on taps

indicators.note: comes back means the girl's name is written backwards

parts.note: Anne is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A sizzling girl returns to the salon for a hair colour.
explanation.definitionFit: This reddish plant extract has been used for centuries to colour hair and skin.

clue.text: Starter from Giosia in exotic Mediterranean food group?

indicators.note: in means the first letter of Giosia goes inside the reworked letters
exotic means the letters of Mediterranean are made strange, rearranged
the starter of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A first course from Giosia, perhaps an Italian chef, in an exotic Mediterranean menu.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exotic' rearranges MEDITERRANEAN and 'in' places G, the first letter of Giosia, among those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Tangerine Dream is a German electronic band named after a citrus fruit, so a group with a food name.

clue.text: Routine as check on ocean with pink hue

indicators.note: to check something is to hold it in, so the word for routine holds the ocean within

parts.note: rote is mechanical routine, as in learning by rote
the sea is the ocean

explanation.surface: A sailor's routine check on the sea at dawn when the sky is pinkish.
explanation.definitionFit: Roseate means rose-coloured, tinted a delicate pink.

clue.text: Composer with band requires an organ case

parts.note: a rib is a raised band or strip, as in knitting
John Cage was an American avant-garde composer

explanation.surface: A composer joining a band needs a carrying case for the organ.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organ' looks like the instrument, but it is a body organ.
explanation.definitionFit: The bony frame of the chest encloses the heart and lungs, acting as a protective container for them.

clue.text: Chef Raymond with beastly disease in food group?

parts.note: Raymond Blanc is a French chef famous in Britain
mange is a skin disease of animals

explanation.surface: A famous chef develops an animal ailment while cooking for a group.
explanation.definitionFit: Blancmange were an English synth-pop duo of the 1980s, named after a milky pudding.

clue.text: Boy in river finds girl

indicators.note: in means the boy's name sits inside the word for river

parts.note: ea is an old dialect word for a river
Len is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A boy wading in a river comes across a girl.
explanation.definitionFit: Elena is a female first name, the Spanish and Italian form of Helen.

clue.text: Choose to charge via crazy prices in food group?

parts.note: to elect is to choose

indicators.note: via means passing through, so the charge goes into the middle of the shuffled letters
crazy means the letters of prices go wild and rearrange

parts.note: to run at is to charge

explanation.surface: Choosing to charge crazy prices for a group's food.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crazy' gives RICPES, and 'via' is an unusual container signal: the charge travels through the shuffled letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The Electric Prunes were a 1960s American psychedelic band named after a dried fruit.

clue.text: Duo in ancient wood

indicators.note: in means the letters lie inside the words ancient wood

explanation.surface: A pair of lovers in an ancient forest.
explanation.definitionFit: A duo is a pair, a couple of things.

clue.text: Trial by TV in scientific birthplace

parts.note: a test is a trial
the tube is slang for television

explanation.surface: A court trial broadcast on TV, set in a laboratory where someone was born.
explanation.definitionFit: A test-tube baby is one conceived in a laboratory dish, so the glass vessel is a lab birthplace.

clue.text: Getting on the ruinous drink when into metal

indicators.note: into means the drink goes inside the symbol for the metal

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
gin is mother's ruin, its old nickname

explanation.surface: Growing older on ruinous drink poured into a metal cup.
explanation.definitionFit: Getting on is an idiom for growing older, advancing in years.

clue.text: South American goddess heard, then seen distraught

indicators.note: heard means the goddess's name is given by its sound, respelt

parts.note: Gaia is the Greek goddess of the earth

indicators.note: distraught means the letters of seen are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A goddess is heard, then glimpsed in great distress, somewhere in South America.
explanation.definitionFit: Guyana is a country on the north coast of South America, so a native of it is South American.

clue.text: Parents splitting apart makes hole

indicators.note: splitting apart means the letters of parents break up and re-form

explanation.surface: A couple's divorce leaves a hole in the family.
explanation.definitionFit: To trepan is to bore a hole in the skull with a surgical saw.

clue.text: Horse meat Jack prepared in food group?

indicators.note: prepared means made ready, so the letters are worked into a new form

parts.note: horse is slang for heroin, abbreviated H
J is the abbreviation for jack in cards

explanation.surface: Horse meat cooked by a man called Jack and served to a group.
explanation.definitionFit: The Jam were a British punk and mod band led by Paul Weller, named after a fruit preserve.

clue.text: This for the poorly remunerated?

parts.note: poorly means ill, not badly paid: wages paid to a worker off ill

explanation.surface: A question about what low earners receive.
explanation.definitionFit: Payment made by an employer to someone away from work through illness.

clue.text: See 23
Supporter excited about great food group?

indicators.note: about means the shuffled letters go round the word for great
excited means the letters of supporter are stirred up and rearranged

parts.note: fab is slang for great

explanation.surface: A fan gets excited about a terrific band.
explanation.walkthrough: 'excited' makes PRESPROUT, and 'about' wraps it round the slang word for great; the surface reads 'about' as 'concerning'.
explanation.definitionFit: Prefab Sprout are an English pop band from the 1980s whose name ends in a vegetable.

clue.text: Drugs rumour binds mum to job pricer

parts.note: E is ecstasy, a drug

indicators.note: binds means holds tight, so the word for rumour wraps round mum and to

parts.note: a stir is a commotion of talk and rumour
ma is mum
taken as written

explanation.surface: Drug gossip ties a mother to a valuation job.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who works out the cost of a job before it starts, like a builder quoting a price.

clue.text: Celtic language makes us cross

parts.note: man means humankind, all of us
X is a cross shape

explanation.surface: A Celtic tongue irritates us.
explanation.definitionFit: The Gaelic tongue of the Isle of Man is one of the Celtic languages.

clue.text: Went to restaurant? Not where energy's provided in a can!

indicators.note: provided in means supplied inside, so the energy goes into the can

parts.note: a tin is a can
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A question about dining out, answered with energy drinks in a can.
explanation.definitionFit: To eat in is to have a meal at home rather than going out.

clue.text: Like Scotsman from some eastern locale?

parts.note: as means like
Ian is a typical Scottish man's name

explanation.surface: Is a Scotsman like someone from the East?
explanation.definitionFit: Coming from the continent of Asia, which lies to the east.

clue.text: Low blow from such Kentuckian musos?

parts.note: blue means low or sad
to blow the gaff, or grass, is to inform on someone

explanation.surface: A low punch thrown by some Kentucky musicians.
explanation.walkthrough: Kentucky is the Bluegrass State, the home of this country music style.
explanation.definitionFit: Bluegrass is a fast acoustic country music played by banjo and fiddle bands from Kentucky.
